fields.Frequency: Continuous; ~300–450 active projects at the B2C/trade mini-project scope (in-store design orders; distinct from the 80–120 active B2B construction register)
fields.Participants: Project Consultant, Store Manager, Head of Trade / Account Management

Automation Opportunity: - Dashboard auto-refreshed from source systems; anomalies auto-flagged; report auto-distributed to stakeholders
Controls: - CTL-429 (ensure controlled execution — Project Tracking & Completion (PA-66.3).)
- operational: Project Consultant sign-off on the workflow output

Time Estimate: - Absorbed into the Project Consultant role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.
